<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {n : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : Fintype k] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (X : Matrix n k Real)
  (β : k → Real) (e : n → Real) [inst_3 : DecidableEq n]

<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen equation (4.25): under diagonal heteroskedastic conditional second moments,
<code>E[σ̂² | X] = n⁻¹ tr(MD)</code> where <code>M</code> is the annihilator matrix and <code>D</code> is the
diagonal matrix of conditional error variances. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {n : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : Fintype k] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Ω : Type u_3}

  (σ2 : n → Real) [inst_3 : DecidableEq n]
  [inst_4 : Invertible (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul X.transpose X)]

  (∀ (i j : n), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω =&gt; instHMul.hMul (e ω i) (e ω j)) μ) →
    (∀ (i j : n),

          Matrix.diagonal σ2 i j) →

        (MeasureTheory.condExp m μ fun ω =&gt; HansenEconometrics.olsSigmaSqHat X (instHAdd.hAdd (X.mulVec β) (e ω)))
        fun x =&gt;
        instHMul.hMul (Real.instInv.inv (Fintype.card n).cast)

              (Matrix.diagonal σ2)).trace</code></pre>
